papers.title: Complex-valued Gaussian Process Regression for Time Series Analysis
papers.abstract: The construction of synthetic complex-valued signals from real-valued observations is an important step in many time series analysis techniques. The most widely used approach is based on the Hilbert transform, which maps the real-valued signal into its quadrature component. In this paper, we define a probabilistic generalization of this approach. We model the observable real-valued signal as the real part of a latent complex-valued Gaussian process. In order to obtain the appropriate statistical relationship between its real and imaginary parts, we define two new classes of complex-valued covariance functions. Through an analysis of simulated chirplets and stochastic oscillations, we show that the resulting Gaussian process complex-valued signal provides a better estimate of the instantaneous amplitude and frequency than the established approaches. Furthermore, the complex-valued Gaussian process regression allows to incorporate prior information about the structure in signal and noise and thereby to tailor the analysis to the features of the signal. As a example, we analyze the non-stationary dynamics of brain oscillations in the alpha band, as measured using magneto-encephalography.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的复高斯过程回归方法用于时间序列分析，与有限元代理模型、植入物设计或生物力学优化无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no optimization constraints, no implant/biomechanics application, and no engineering design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善实值信号中瞬时幅值和频率的估计精度
summary_zh.method: 定义复高斯过程及新型协方差函数，建模实值信号为隐复信号的实部
summary_zh.result: 在合成信号和真实脑磁图数据上优于希尔伯特变换方法
summary_zh.validation: 基于模拟数据（chirplets和随机振荡）及脑磁图数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve estimation of instantaneous amplitude and frequency from real-valued signals using a probabilistic framework.
summary_en.method: A complex-valued Gaussian process with novel covariance functions models the latent complex signal.
summary_en.result: The method provides better estimates than Hilbert transform-based approaches on simulated and real MEG data.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on synthetic chirplets and stochastic oscillations, and applied to real MEG data.

papers.title: Active Deep Learning for Classification of Hyperspectral Images
papers.abstract: Active deep learning classification of hyperspectral images is considered in this paper. Deep learning has achieved success in many applications, but good-quality labeled samples are needed to construct a deep learning network. It is expensive getting good labeled samples in hyperspectral images for remote sensing applications. An active learning algorithm based on a weighted incremental dictionary learning is proposed for such applications. The proposed algorithm selects training samples that maximize two selection criteria, namely representative and uncertainty. This algorithm trains a deep network efficiently by actively selecting training samples at each iteration. The proposed algorithm is applied for the classification of hyperspectral images, and compared with other classification algorithms employing active learning. It is shown that the proposed algorithm is efficient and effective in classifying hyperspectral images.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户方向（FEA代理建模）无关，属于高光谱图像分类。
llm.why_not_core: No finite element analysis, surrogate modeling, optimization, or biomedical/mechanical design context. Focuses solely on hyperspectral image classification in remote sensing.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高光谱图像分类中标记样本获取昂贵的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于加权增量字典学习的主动学习算法，同时考虑代表性和不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在高光谱图像分类中效率高且有效。
summary_zh.validation: 与其他主动学习分类算法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Addresses the challenge of expensive labeled sample acquisition in hyperspectral image classification.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning algorithm using weighted incremental dictionary learning that selects samples based on representativeness and uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates efficient and effective classification of hyperspectral images.
summary_en.validation: Compared against other active learning classification methods on hyperspectral datasets.

papers.title: Study of selective laser melting (SLM) Inconel 718 part surface improvement by electrochemical polishing
papers.first_author_affiliation: SIMTech - Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology, 71 Nanyang Dr., 638075, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Baicheng Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: SIMTech - Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology, 71 Nanyang Dr., 638075, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Wei Jun
corresponding_authors.affiliation: SIMTech - Singapore Institute of Manufacturing Technology, 71 Nanyang Dr., 638075, Singapore

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM Inconel 718的表面抛光，与生物医学植入物应力屏蔽和多孔结构无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no porous structure for stress shielding, no mechanical testing (fatigue/compression), no osseointegration, and material is Inconel 718 not used for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善SLM Inconel 718零件的表面质量
summary_zh.method: 采用电化学抛光对SLM零件进行后处理
summary_zh.result: 显著降低表面粗糙度，改善表面形貌
summary_zh.validation: 通过表面粗糙度测量和SEM表征

summary_en.motivation: To improve the surface quality of SLM-fabricated Inconel 718 parts for better performance.
summary_en.method: Electrochemical polishing was applied as a post-processing technique to SLM Inconel 718 samples.
summary_en.result: Surface roughness was significantly reduced and surface morphology improved after polishing.
summary_en.validation: Validation via surface roughness measurements and SEM imaging.

papers.title: Microstructure stability of γ-TiAl produced by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Metals and Hybrid Materials, Institute of Materials Research, German Aerospace Center, Linder Höhe, 51147, Cologne, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Joachim Gussone
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Metals and Hybrid Materials, Institute of Materials Research, German Aerospace Center, Linder Höhe, 51147, Cologne, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究γ-TiAl合金的微观结构稳定性，与用户关注的生物医用增材制造方向（多孔结构、应力遮挡、疲劳性能）无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on microstructure stability of γ-TiAl for aerospace applications, with no porous structures, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), surface morphology, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备γ-TiAl合金的微观结构稳定性
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化技术制备γ-TiAl样品并进行微观结构分析
summary_zh.result: 揭示了SLM过程中γ-TiAl的相变和微观组织演化规律
summary_zh.validation: 通过显微组织观察验证

summary_en.motivation: The motivation is to investigate the microstructure stability of γ-TiAl alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for high-temperature applications.
summary_en.method: The method involves producing γ-TiAl samples via selective laser melting and characterizing the as-built and heat-treated microstructures.
summary_en.result: The results show the phase transformations and microstructural evolution during SLM and subsequent thermal exposure.
summary_en.validation: Validation is based on microstructural analysis using microscopy techniques.
